title: MIAMI Beach Wedding or Vow Renewal Ceremony
includes: beach wedding or renewal of vows ceremony
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Miami's turquoise waters and white beaches make the perfect backdrop for a romantic, casual and barefoot beach wedding ceremony or renewal of vows ceremony performed by a Florida licensed officiant. The ceremony is followed by a beach champagne toast and a beach photo shoot with 50 pictures.
Ceremonies are offered in English or German.
